This duality implies that emotional processes either occupy unique neural substrata or are extensions of existing sensory-motor computations. The cortical projection duality establishes a foundational mapping between physical brain regions and mental functions. The perceptual activation chain formalizes how external stimuli propagate through sensory organs to cortical processing and ultimately to conscious awareness.
